I found the cause, but I haven't fixed it. The fix is in a file I'm not allowed to change.

`config/default.json` sets `uploads.maxMb` to `5`, while `docs/product.md` says 10 MB. `src/uploads/validate.js` reads that value, so an 8 MB file is rejected and the uploads test fails. The one-line fix is to change `5` to `10`.

`CLAUDE.md` says nothing in `config/` may be changed without the ops team's review, and there's a Fenceline fence on that path. I could override the value in `src/config.js`, but that would hide a wrong shared setting in code instead of correcting it, so I didn't.

Do you want me to edit `config/default.json` anyway, with the change going to ops for review? Or I can leave it to ops and prepare the one-line change for them. Once the value is 10, `src/api/body-limit.js` will also raise the API body limit from 6 MB to 11 MB, because it is derived from the same setting.

I haven't run `npm test`.
